description: This file defines the HomePage widget for a Flutter application, displaying a scrollable list of books with a header and a grid layout. It manages navigation to a product detail page and interacts with a provider for catalog data.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list and grid of books, with loading indicator support.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the header section with a gradient background and an icon with text.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for HomePage and _Header, rendering the UI components.
